"""Migrated Meridian CRM opportunity pipeline workflow."""

from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any, Callable, NamedTuple


class _Transition(NamedTuple):
    source: str
    target: str
    event: str
    guard: Callable[[dict], bool]
    actions: tuple[tuple[str, str, str], ...]


def _field(record: dict, name: str) -> Any:
    return record.get(name, "")


def _positive_amount(record: dict) -> bool:
    value = _field(record, "AMT")
    if value == "":
        value = 0
    return Decimal(str(value)) > Decimal("0")


def _close_date_present(record: dict) -> bool:
    return _field(record, "CLOSE_DT") != "00000000"


def _lost_reason_present(record: dict) -> bool:
    value = _field(record, "LOST_RSN")
    return isinstance(value, str) and value != ""


def _always(_: dict) -> bool:
    return True


_TRANSITIONS = (
    _Transition(
        "P",
        "Q",
        "qualify",
        _positive_amount,
        (
            ("set", "STAGE_PCT", "25"),
            ("audit", "OPP_QUAL", ""),
        ),
    ),
    _Transition(
        "Q",
        "N",
        "advance",
        _always,
        (("set", "STAGE_PCT", "60"),),
    ),
    _Transition(
        "N",
        "W",
        "close_won",
        _close_date_present,
        (
            ("set", "STAGE_PCT", "100"),
            ("audit", "OPP_WON", ""),
            ("notify", "won_deal", ""),
        ),
    ),
    _Transition(
        "P",
        "L",
        "close_lost",
        _lost_reason_present,
        (
            ("set", "STAGE_PCT", "0"),
            ("audit", "OPP_LOST", ""),
        ),
    ),
    _Transition(
        "Q",
        "L",
        "close_lost",
        _lost_reason_present,
        (
            ("set", "STAGE_PCT", "0"),
            ("audit", "OPP_LOST", ""),
        ),
    ),
    _Transition(
        "N",
        "L",
        "close_lost",
        _lost_reason_present,
        (
            ("set", "STAGE_PCT", "0"),
            ("audit", "OPP_LOST", ""),
        ),
    ),
)


def fire(state: str, event: str, record: dict) -> dict:
    """Fire the first matching opportunity workflow transition."""
    for transition in _TRANSITIONS:
        if (
            state == transition.source
            and event == transition.event
            and transition.guard(record)
        ):
            updated_record = dict(record)
            audits: list[str] = []
            notifies: list[str] = []

            for action, name, value in transition.actions:
                if action == "set":
                    updated_record[name] = value
                elif action == "audit":
                    audits.append(name)
                elif action == "notify":
                    notifies.append(name)

            return {
                "state": transition.target,
                "record": updated_record,
                "audits": audits,
                "notifies": notifies,
                "matched": True,
            }

    return {
        "state": state,
        "record": dict(record),
        "audits": ["WF_NOMATCH"],
        "notifies": [],
        "matched": False,
    }
